slots.name: CPI inflation rate
slots.sentence: Warsh also referred to another gauge of inflation, the consumer price index , which is running at 3.4%.

slots.name: September 2024 rate change
slots.sentence: He claimed the Fed’s half-point rate cut in September 2024, for example, was intended to help Democrats in that year’s election.

slots.name: scheduled Fed meetings before midterm elections
slots.sentence: The Fed is scheduled to meet twice before the upcoming midterm elections, in September and late October.

slots.sentence: That’s “well above” the roughly one-third that saw such increases in the two decades before the pandemic.

slots.name: Jackson Hole attendees
slots.sentence: A year ago, then-Fed Chair Jerome Powell received a standing ovation from the roughly 120 or so attendees before he even delivered his speech.

slots.name: two-year Treasury yield
slots.sentence: The yield on the two-year Treasury, which closely tracks expectations for what the Fed will do with its federal funds rate, moved from 4.22% to 4.30%, a sign that investors expect short-term yields to move higher.

slots.name: Fed's preferred inflation measure
slots.sentence: According to the Fed’s preferred measure, it was 3.7% in July .

slots.name: historical inflation rate
slots.sentence: In 2022, with pandemic-era inflation having soared to 9.1%, Powell signaled the Fed would continue to sharply raise interest rates in a fight against runaway prices, and he acknowledged that such maneuvers would bring “pain” to consumers and businesses.

slots.name: implied probability of September rate hike
slots.sentence: Wall Street investors now see the chances of a rate hike at the Fed’s Sept. 15-16 meeting as basically a coin flip, according to futures pricing tracked by CME FedWatch , up from about one-third before Warsh spoke.

slots.name: next Fed meeting date
slots.sentence: The Fed next meets Sept. 15-16, and Warsh’s remarks don’t necessarily signal that the central bank will raise rates then.
